lines.say: A student sold dots on a screen for a million fucking dollars.
England, two thousand five. Alex, twenty one, was sweating a student loan.
So he builds one ugly web page. A million pixels, a dollar each, hundred dollar minimum.
Companies lost their damn minds. In months he made one million, thirty seven thousand dollars.
The last thousand pixels went on eBay for thirty eight grand. For a fucking speck.
Then hackers emailed him to pay up, first five grand, and then fifty grand.
He refused to pay a damn cent, so they knocked his whole site offline.
Those links people paid for? By twenty seventeen, about one in five was dead as shit.
Happy Cyber Monday. Nobody checked those links, and your client list rots the same damn way.
Message Health spots who's gone quiet, and sends each one a text.
Comment KEEP to get a full retention audit.
